sources.catalog_grain: degree_course_id; compared as university_id + degree_id + course_id

definitions.same_university: non-empty normalized university_id sets are exactly equal
definitions.same_degree: old and new full normalized degree_id sets have a non-empty exact intersection
definitions.structural_comparison_grain: all catalog rows in exact shared degree_id values; all rows when no degree is shared
definitions.clean_temporal_replacement: DIRECT_REPLACEMENT or ONE_SEMESTER_GAP with no overlap
definitions.strict_candidate: same exact university and identical degree sets; different course_id; name similarity >= 0.85; exact faculty, credits, course type, requirement type, planned year and planned semester agreement; direct or one-semester-gap replacement without overlap
definitions.confirmation_rule: no diagnostic similarity can create confirmed_equivalent; official university evidence is required
